# Questions — task-20261121-101500-k2m4

## 1. claude-2 could not finish its task either: start it once more, or stop it?
The task went up every step the harness has: the retries of its session, a new session, and the agents that held it
before claude-2 (claude-1, żółw-agent). The last runs of claude-2 went bad too: `no_status`.

a) start it once more — claude-2 begins a new session, briefed on where the work stands; if that goes bad too, the
   task fails, and you are not asked again
b) stop the task — nothing more runs on it; the work of a team's member goes to its lead, which is told on the bus

**Recommended:** b) — every step went bad, so one more run is unlikely to go better; look at the worktree and the
branch yourself (the harness)
